bill.title: A resolution honoring and celebrating National Boys and Girls Club Week.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text: CR S3946)

classification.plainSummary:
A resolution honoring and celebrating National Boys and Girls Club Week.

This is a commemorative or honorific measure ("celebrating"). It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
